title: Hayley Atwell Hints at a Monday Avengers: Doomsday Trailer
excerpt:
Atwell told fans she believes a new trailer may arrive Monday.
Marvel has not officially confirmed the release timing.
body_md:
Hayley Atwell, who portrays Peggy Carter in Marvel productions, discussed a possible new Avengers: Doomsday trailer while greeting fans after a stage performance. She said she thought the trailer would arrive on Monday, then wondered aloud whether she had been allowed to reveal that information.

Atwell also said she had seen the trailer and found it impressive. When a fan asked whether it contained sad moments, she suggested there would be emotional material without revealing specific plot details.

The Monday in question is November 23, 2026. Some fans have speculated about a release during Monday Night Football, but that is only a theory. Marvel Studios has not officially confirmed the date or time.
